entry.author: Ministry for Pacific Peoples
entry.summary:
The Secretary for Pacific Peoples, Gerardine Clifford-Lidstone welcomes you to join the celebrations for ‘Epetoma o te reo Māori Kūki ‘Āirani – Cook Islands Language Week.
This year’s theme is 'Ātuitui’ia au ki te au peu o tōku kāinga Ipukarea, which means, "connect me to the traditions & culture of my homeland".

Resources and calendar of events found right here:
https://www.mpp.govt.nz/programmes/pacific-language-weeks/cook-islands-language-week/
